Name: Hugs and Kisses - kiss.wav Replaced With Flamingo mWAH
Author: sirvexywexy
Description:
I thought it would be funny if I changed the sound of the kiss in this mod to the sound Flamingo makes in the below video when Sammy the Strawberry is kissing his lovely girlfriend, Gorange the Orange. 

[youtube]lWiqKbmnXnk[/youtube]

I obviously did not make the video, that is [url=https://www.youtube.com/@flamingo]Flamingo[/url].
I also did not make the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21019]Hugs and Kisses Continued[/url]﻿ which was done by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/JoXW?gameId=1303]JoXW[/url].
The original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10062]Hugs and Kisses[/url] mod was made by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/aedenthorn?gameId=1303]aedenthorn[/url]﻿.
This was just a silly little joke and if I understand right, both authors allow this because I am obviously NOT going to earn any money from this.
